name: Treasurr
subtitle: Your seedbox, in your pocket
localizedDescription: A personal dashboard for a self-hosted media server: live speeds, who's watching, downloads, service status and fun watch stats. Pairs with its own gateway by QR code; it does nothing without one.

versions.localizedDescription: Notes: a lightbulb on every tab, and Settings → Your notes
Transcode stats: stream badge and a "How it played" card
Publish through a seedbox relay instead of a token

versionDescription: Notes: a lightbulb on every tab, and Settings → Your notes

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scan the pairing code shown on your seedbox.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Treasurr locks with Face ID and asks again before changing anything.
